notes:
# Improved scheduling {calendar}
Date, time and time-zone pickers are now panels under the field, and they
close when you click away.

# Flexible time entry {clock}
Type 0900, 9am, 2:30pm or 14:30 — the panel says back what it understood
before you commit to it.

# Updates arrive by themselves {download}
RecordLah checks on every launch and installs a new build without a disk
image or a Gatekeeper prompt.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The finished-recording view opens in 47ms instead of 500, so the Done tab
  no longer flickers on the way in.
- About and Help screens, reachable from the RecordLah menu.
- Time zones read as Asia/Hong Kong rather than Asia/Hong_Kong.
- The schedule row folds into two rows on a narrow window instead of
  truncating every field.
- The calendar will not page back past the current month.
- Closing the window during a recording asks instead of just closing.
- Update checks wait until a recording has finished.
- The update panel says what changed in plain words, stays put while it
  checks, and opens over the app rather than against the screen edge.
- The refresh and ? marks in the toolbar are legible again.
